title: Senior Level - Executive Assistant to VIPs
description:
Top 1% concierge and UHNW service professionals who make the impossible happen daily — this one's for you. Apply here: 
/appqyBZJyyxs1htVk/pagUGh0eZcqVb3LOA/form



We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for the person who sets the standard that everyone else on the tea
asures themselves against. Someone who has done this work at a senior level, knows what great looks like from the inside, and is ready to build something.



About the Company:

We run an AI-native lifestyle management platform for the world's most demanding clients — founders, athletes, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals who expect their personal and professional lives to run without friction.



Our members do not manage logistics. We do. Across travel, dining, private experiences, luxury goods, and wellness — everything is handled, anticipated, and elevated by a team that operates at the highest level of personal service.



We have built the content operations side of this business. Now we are scaling the member experience function, and we need a Lead Lifestyle Manager to be the first senior hire in that team.





The Role



This is a dual mandate: you deliver exceptional service to members directly, and you set the bar for the team that grows around you.



On the member side, you are managing a live queue of requests across multiple members simultaneously. Elevating confirmed plans, securing access that others cannot get, building partner relationships that make the impossible routine. The pace is high. The standard is higher.



On the leadership side, you are the benchmark. As the team scales, you will bring new Lifestyle Managers up to speed, review their work, and hold the quality line on every member interaction that goes out.



IMPORTANT: Please read the responsibilities section carefully before applying — we assess candidates directly on what is listed below, and the process is thorough by design.



Compensation

* Competitive salary: $1,900 - $2,100 USD per month (depending on experience)



Benefits

* Paid time off

* Wellbeing stipend



Working Hours

* Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

* Full-time only (40 hours per week)

* This is a high-output role, especially in the early period as the team builds. We are looking for someone who is energised by that, not surprised by it.



Core Responsibilities



Member Experience

* Triage and manage a high-volume live queue across dining, experiences, wellness, and luxury goods simultaneously, at a pace.

* Elevate confirmed plans before members ask. Personal touches, upgraded access, and proactive picks that show you actually know them.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, and venues globally to secure what others can't, and build the relationships that make that repeatable.

* Communicate with members and partners with precision and warmth. Right detail, right tone, right 
nt.

* Use our Claude-powered AI platform to research and build offers fast, applying your own judgment before anything reaches a member.

* Document every preference, interaction, and partner note so the next person picking up a request knows exactly where things stand.



Team Leadership

* Own the quality bar for everything the team sends out and hold it without being asked.

* Onboard and upskill incoming Lifestyle Managers, transferring your instincts and standards to the people behind you.

* Review work, give direct feedback, and flag problems to leadership before they become issues.



You're Perfect for This Role If You

* Have 5+ years serving wealthy or high-profile principals in a senior client-facing role — five-star guest experience, principal-level EA, luxury concierge, or equivalent where the margin for error was zero.

* Have led or mentored a team before, formally or not, and understand what it means to be accountable for someone else's output.

* Speak and write English at a native level. Polished enough for a member message and direct enough for a cold call to a London hotel manager.

* Pick up the phone first, know who to ask for, and never let "fully booked" be the end of the conversation.

* Notice what members need before they say it, not through research, but through the pattern recognition that comes from years of real client proximity.

* Have worked in high-volume, high-pressure environments where everything is urgent and you recalibrate rather than freeze.

* Handle confidential client information and NDA-bound relationships as a matter of course.

* Are professional and composed by default. Warm with members, direct with partners, serious when it counts.



Nice to Have

* First-hand personal knowledge of luxury properties, restaurants, and experiences in London, New York, Paris, Dubai, Tokyo, or Singapore.

* An existing network of contacts at high-end hotels, restaurants, or lifestyle providers built through years of relationship work.

* Experience moving between an individual contributor role and a team leadership role — comfortable doing the work and directing others doing it.

* Familiarity with AI tools as part of a daily professional workflow.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Operations & Knowledge-System Operator — AI-Native Infrastructure Business
description:
## About us, in plain terms



Blue Harbour (
)  helps large infrastructure organisations achieve **capital certainty** — a clear, governed, trustworthy view of where their capital programmes stand and the decisions behind them. We use AI to deliver that with a speed and diligence traditional consulting can't match: what used to take a consulting team weeks, we turn around fast and well. We're already live with our first major client in New Zealand, opening in Australia next, and built to expand into new markets after that.



AI is *how we work*, not what we sell. We sell certainty; AI is our edge in producing it.



We're hiring our **first operator** — the person who runs the commercial engine of the business so it keeps running and replicating into new markets.



## The role in one line



Run the commercial machine end-to-end — the product-and-knowledge engine that turns delivered work into reusable assets, the business-development pipeline, the executive backbone, and research — with the judgment to know what to handle and what to escalate.



## What you'll actually do



- **Run the product-and-knowledge engine — this is the heart of the role.** We turn every piece of delivered work into reusable, sellable product: the features, methods and analysis built for one client become the templates, modules and playbooks we deploy for the next. 



We run a structured, AI-operated "second brain" that several people contribute to, and it's already built. Your job is to keep it coherent *and* to drive the loop that converts one-off delivery into canonical, reusable assets — enforce the conventions, keep the canonical material clean and current, turn finished work into templates, and make the repeatable version of what we do one of our most valuable assets. You steward and systematise against the founder's "what good looks like"; you don't have to author the product judgment, you have to capture and compound it.



- **Run the growth pipeline — Australia next.** Research and qualify the organisations we'd work with as we open a new market — whether we partner to sell and deliver, or go direct — keep the CRM current, and draft the outreach and pitches. You run the funnel right up to the close; the founder holds the relationships and closes. As you go, you help capture *how* it's done — the repeatable version of "find and win the next market" is itself one of the assets we're building.

- **Hold the executive backbone.** Inbox, calendar, follow-up, focus protection. Nothing drops.

- **Build the pipeline of high-value rooms and relationships.** Research and organise the events, forums, and introductions that grow our network in target markets. You handle the research and logistics; the founder handles the relationships once he's in the room.

- **Run onboarding for new tea
mbers.** As we bring on technical and delivery people, you run the onboarding scaffolding — training flow, a guided path through the system, the day-to-day "where does this live" — so they get productive without the founder running it. (You're building the scaffolding a future delivery team will run.)

- **Draft offers of service** from a brief to ~70% off our template library; the founder takes them the rest of the way.

- **Run market and competitive research** — pricing, positioning, landscape, and which market to open next — delivered as a clear, decision-useful read with sources, not a pile of links.



You'll use AI throughout — the same way the business does, as the tool that makes the work fast and thorough. Day one, that means using AI with judgment to do real work; over time, you'll grow into genuinely running an AI-operated company, a skill that compounds and that almost no one has yet.



## What you get



- **USD 2,000–3,000/month**, depending on experience. This is a **full-time, single-client role**, and we pay a fair full-time rate specifically so you don't need a second client splitting your focus. The pay and the single-client commitment are two halves of the same deal.

- **Benefits from day one:** private health cover (HMO), a 13th-month equivalent, paid leave, and an equipment/internet allowance. We're hiring for the long term and we structure the role that way.

- **A provided AI tooling seat.**

- **Real growth without having to leave to get it.** You'll become fluent in running an AI-native operation — a rare and rising skill — and the role's scope deepens as the business opens new markets.

- **Stability.** This is a long-term seat at a growing business, not a project or a stop-gap. We're looking for someone who wants one solid, high-trust role for years, not the next rung.



## Ramp & hours



- Part-time for the first 6–8 weeks while you learn the system, **paid as a fixed monthly retainer** (not pro-rata), then full rate once you're up to speed — sooner if you're ready.

- Remote, with a **minimum 4 hours' daily overlap with New Zealand business hours** (Manila daytime — no night shifts). When in your day the rest of the work happens is flexible; the overlap and "nothing drops" are not.



## Who this is for



If you've run an operation end-to-end and been trusted with the whole picture before, you'll recognize this role. We're looking for someone who:



- leads with **judgment** — knows what to handle, what to escalate, and what to push back on;

- turns **one-offs into reusable assets** — instinctively makes the second version a template, not another from-scratch job, and can tell what's reusable from what's client-specific;

- thinks in **systems and conventions** — can keep a shared system coherent as more people use it, without bottlenecking everything through themselves;

- **finishes** — work arrives done and self-checked, not at 80%-and-back-to-you;

- writes **clearly and fast**, and can hold someone else's voice;

- uses **AI with judgment** — knows when to trust it, when not to, and when to do it by hand;

- is **discreet by instinct**, not just when told;

- wants a **long-term, single-client seat** and the security that comes with it.



This is a high-responsibility, high-ownership role. The right person is bracing for that — for owning outcomes and holding the line on what matters — not for anything else.

title: Outbound Sales — Phone Closer | Cebu | Full-Time
description:
This is a phone sales role. You call people, you qualify fast, you close or you move on. That's the job.



We sell a product that protects elderly people at home. The category is growing, the product works, and the partners we've signed prove it has legs. You don't need to know more than that until you can prove you can sell.



**The job**



80–120 outbound dials daily across USA time zones. You'll speak to adult children worrying about a parent, or the seniors themselves. You'll identify urgency in under 60 seconds and either push toward a close or cut the call. No handholding, no long sales cycles, no committee decisions.



**What gets you an interview**



5+ years closing B2C on the phone. You know your numbers cold — close rate, average call length, monthly revenue generated. You've sold something people didn't know they needed and made them believe they did. Your English is clean and your accent doesn't get in the way.



**What kills your application immediately**



Sending a CV with no numbers on it. Describing yourself as a "team player." Having 5 years of experience that's actually the same year repeated five times.





**Apply**



Send a 90-second voice note. Tell us your best month in sales, what you were selling, and what made that month happen. Nothing else needed.

We are looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our team's visual content needs. title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you’re interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.



Why strong setters join us



We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth.



If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.



01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there’s no ceiling on what you can earn each month.



02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You’ll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what’s working, coach on what isn’t, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.



03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You’ll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — every one, on top of the base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month



The status bonus — how it works:



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 = 10%

Hit 16 = 15%

Hit 20 = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an extra ~$375/month. At Gold level, that’s an extra ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we’ll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you’ll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.



Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.



Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.



Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.



Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.



Who we’re looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.



A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.



Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.



Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.



Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.



What you’re walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously.



You’ll know exactly what’s expected, exactly what you’ll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.



Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out

mbers (operations, finance, leadership)

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager — Role & Playbook

Business: Website design for restaurants & local businesses Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok,
 The one job: Grow a relevant audience and turn it into DMs ? qualified leads ? paying clients.



The Goal (read this first)

Follower count is not the goal. The goal is DMs from restaurant owners that turn into paying clients. A 2,000-follower account full of local restaurant owners beats a 50,000-follower account full of random people every single time. At the same time this does not mean we do not want to grow the account the more followers we have the higher chance we can turn viewers and followers into leads.

Every post must do one of three jobs: get discovered (Top of Funnel), build trust (Middle of Funnel), or drive a DM (Bottom of Funnel). If a post does none of these, don't post it.

North-star metric: number of qualified DMs / leads passed to the owner per week. Secondary metrics: shares, saves, profile visits, follower growth (relevant followers only). Vanity metrics to ignore: raw likes, total followers without context.



The Funnel — what to post and how much

Use this mix as the default. Early on (under ~2k followers) lean heavier on Top of Funnel to grow reach; once the audience builds, shift more toward Middle and Bottom.

Funnel tier

% of posts

Goal

Metric that proves it worked

Top (TOFU)

~50%

Get discovered by people who don't know us

Reach, shares, new follows

Middle (MOFU)

~30%

Prove we know our stuff

Saves, comments, profile visits

Bottom (BOFU)

~20%

Turn warm followers into DMs

DMs, link clicks, leads



TOP OF FUNNEL — Viral Hooks, Broad Topics, Shares

Purpose: reach strangers and get shared. These are broad, visual, and satisfying. No selling.

Content types:

Before/after redesigns of real restaurant sites

"Redesigning a real local restaurant" series — pick a local spot with a bad site, rebuild it, reveal the transformation (this is the flagship format)

Speed builds — sped-up "watch me build a restaurant site in 60 seconds"

Broad relatable hooks about bad restaurant websites

Hook bank (the first 1–2 seconds d
 everything):

"This restaurant has amazing food and a website that's quietly killing their business."

"I redesigned a local restaurant's website without them asking — here's what I changed."

"POV: you Google a restaurant and this is their website."

"Your restaurant's website is losing you customers every day. Here's proof."

MIDDLE OF FUNNEL — Education, Frameworks, Saves

Purpose: convince people who found us that we're the expert. Useful enough to save and send to a friend.

Content types:

Frameworks: "5 things every restaurant website needs (most miss #3)"

Mistakes: "3 things wrong with most restaurant websites"

Myth-busting: "Why relying on just a
 page is costing you money"

Mini-explainers: online ordering, mobile speed, Google rankings — in plain English

Hook bank:

"5 things every restaurant website needs — most are missing at least two."

"The 3-second test: if your site fails this, you're losing diners."

"Stop relying on DoorDash for your online presence. Here's why."

BOTTOM OF FUNNEL — Client Wins, Hard Pitches, DMs

Purpose: turn warm followers into conversations. Direct, proof-driven, with a clear next step.

Content types:

Client wins / results: "We rebuilt [restaurant]'s site and their online orders went up — here's how."

Transparent breakdowns: "Here's exactly what we did for this restaurant and what it cost."

Direct offers: the comment-to-DM play (below)

Hook bank:

"We rebuilt this restaurant's website. Look at the difference."

"Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview of your restaurant's new website."

"Want to see what your restaurant's site could look like? DM us 'WEBSITE'."



The Weekly Posting Schedule

Start at 5 posts/week (one per weekday), batched and scheduled a week ahead. Same vertical video gets posted to all three platforms — produce once, repurpose everywhere.

Day

Funnel

Post

Monday

TOFU

Before/after of a recent build

Tuesday

MOFU

Educational framework / mistakes post

Wednesday

TOFU

Redesign series — Part 1 (the bad site + "let's fix it")

Thursday

BOFU

Client win / testimonial / results

Friday

TOFU

Redesign series — Part 2 (the reveal) + soft CTA



Rotate so that over two weeks you hit roughly 6 TOFU, 2 MOFU, 2 BOFU. To push more leads, swap a TOFU slot for a second BOFU once the audience is warm.



The Social Media Manager's Exact Responsibilities

Every week (planning — sent to owner for approval)

Build the week's content calendar: what posts, which funnel tier, what day.

Write the script and hook for each post (the spoken/on-screen lines).

Write the caption and CTA for each post.

Edit the raw footage the owner provides into finished vertical reels — captions, hook on screen, trending audio, tight pacing, strong first frame.

Schedule every post across Instagram, TikTok, and
.

Every day

Confirm the scheduled post went live on all three platforms.

Engage in the first 60 minutes after posting — reply to every comment (this is when reach is d
).

Reply to all DMs. Qualify lightly, log every lead in the tracker, and flag warm ones to the owner immediately.

Spend 20–30 min commenting on target accounts — local restaurants, local business pages, food bloggers — to get the account in front of the right people.

Every month

Report: follower growth, top posts, saves/shares, DMs, leads passed. Note what worked and adjust the mix.



How to Gain REAL Followers (not junk)

Tag the restaurant in every redesign. When you feature a real local spot, tag them — they often reshare to their own followers (their customers and other owners). This is the single best source of relevant reach.

Use local + niche tags: location tags for the city/region, plus restaurant/local-business hashtags. Skip giant generic tags.

Reply to every comment and DM. Conversation tells the algorithm the content matters, and it builds real relationships.

Be consistent. 5 posts every week beats 15 one week and none the next.

Never buy followers, likes, or use engagement pods. It poisons your reach and brings zero buyers.



The DM ? Lead Handoff (where the money is)

This is the whole point. The conversion mechanic:

BOTTOM-of-funnel posts end with a comment-to-DM call to action — "Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview."

Use a tool like ManyChat to auto-DM everyone who comments the keyword. This spikes engagement and drops a warm lead straight into the inbox.

The SMM responds, asks 1–2 light qualifying questions (restaurant name, do they have a site now), and logs the lead in the tracker.

Anyone who shows real interest gets flagged to the owner to close.

Every DM is a potential client. The SMM's job is to start the conversation and hand the owner someone ready to talk.



What the Owner Provides

The SMM can't build the websites — that's you. Your weekly input is small:

Raw footage: screen recordings of builds, before/after captures, the occasional talking-head hook. Batch it once a week into a shared folder.

Approve the calendar the SMM sends.

Close the warm leads the SMM hands you.



Tools

Scheduling:Google Calendar (or the free native Instagram/TikTok schedulers)

Editing: CapCut

Comment-to-DM automation: ManyChat

Content calendar + lead log: Google Sheets or Notion (shared with the owner)



The Rule That Keeps Everyone Honest

Posts are judged by leads, not likes. A post with 200 likes and zero DMs failed. A post with 30 likes that produced two DMs from restaurant owners succeeded. Optimize relentlessly for the conversation, not the applause. We still do need followers, likes, and shares. It is not okay to not get leads or likes.

title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.  



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

description:

If you've hit consistent daily activity targets, kept a clean CRM, and love the feeling of getting a prospect to say "yes, book me in" - keep reading. If you're looking to coast, this isn't your role.



What You'll Be Setting Appointments For:

An AI-powered lead generation system built for Home Services businesses (painters, remodelers, and similar trades). The system generates leads, qualifies them with AI voice + text agents, and books appointments directly on our clients' calendars. It works. We took one painter from $295K/year to $1.5M in 14 months. We have killer case studies, a product that delivers, and a closer who converts.



The Reality of This Role:

This is consistent, focused work. You'll be working warm inbound leads AND running outbound to home services business owners. Your one job: get qualified decision-makers on the calendar. A closer handles the rest. Most people don't have the discipline for this. The ones who do will earn well and grow with us.



Your Mission:

- Work inbound leads fast - speed to lead is everything.

- Run outbound to home services business owners (phone + text + LinkedIn).

- Qualify prospects and book them onto the closer's calendar using GHL.

- Keep the pipeline clean and updated - no leads left behind.

- Hit your daily booked-meeting targets. Then beat them.



Who We're Looking For:

- Consistent and disciplined - you show up, dial, and hit targets without being chased.

- Phone confidence - comfortable starting conversations with business owners cold.

- 1+ year of appointment setting or outbound prospecting experience (proven results, not just "experience")

- Excellent written and spoken English

- A self-starter who manages their own activity without hand-holding

- Hungry - you want to earn commission on every meeting that closes



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Set appointments for home services / trades / local business owners

- Worked for a digital/marketing agency or B2B service business

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Comfortable with SMS/text and
 outreach alongside phone calls

- AI tools in your daily workflow (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)



You must be able to work US business hours (8am–5pm HST / 11pm–8am PHT). This is a firm requirement - not flexible.



Employment:

Part-time or full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term only. We're not interested in job-hoppers.



Compensation:

Uncapped commission. Base starting 30k-50k PHP/month + commission per closed deal that you set + residual recurring commission (Wise/Payoneer paid bi-weekly). Top setters double their base monthly when the closer converts. 13th month considered for long-term hires.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY - IF YOU CAN'T FOLLOW DIRECTIONS, YOU CAN'T BOOK FOR US)



- Use 7 apply points 

-
 subject must start with "SDR777" and include your name

- Number your answers 1–7 as outlined below.



1) How many outbound dials per day are you comfortable making?

2) Are you a setter, a closer, or both? Be honest.

3) How many meetings have you personally booked? Give us real numbers (meetings set, show rate, deal outcomes if known).

4) Why should we pick you over every other applicant? Sell us on you as a setter.

5) Your DISC score in the format D _ / I _ / S _ / C _ (required). If it's been more than 2 years since you took it, retake it in your OnlineJobs dashboard.

6) Your PHP monthly base rate + commission expectations + earliest start date.

7) Record a 2-5 minute video introducing yourself and selling us on why you're the right person for this role, include the link in your application. No video, no review.



Applications without all items above and proper subject won't be opened.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in filling calendars. If that's you, we want to hear from you.

mber who lives at the intersection of creative content production and digital marketing execution.

The right candidate has worked in an agency or freelance environment where they developed real skills across multiple creative and marketing disciplines. You will not just support a plan; you will be the person who brings it to life.

You will work directly with our Local Marketing Manager, who owns the strategy and hands you clear direction. Your job is to execute it exceptionally well, at high volume, with strong creative judgment and AI as a force multiplier.

This is a long-term position with a team that invests in its people, wherever in the world they are based.



--------------------



Compensation & Hours



$26,000–$32,000 USD per year, paid monthly

Hours: US Eastern Time (EST), Monday–Friday. This is a hard requirement. Please only apply if you can genuinely commit to EST business hours.



--------------------



What You Will Do



Edit and produce short-form video content for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube

Design graphics and visuals for social media, digital ads, and print advertising

Build, organize, and maintain our Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, ensuring all brand assets are properly stored, labeled, and accessible

Produce on-brand
 campaigns and templates

Manage and optimize our Google Business Profile and local SEO presence

--------------------



Who You Are



You have worked at a small digital marketing agency or carried multiple clients as a freelancer. You take creative direction well and also bring ideas to the table. You see a gap and fill it without being asked. You understand that content without a plan is just noise, and a plan without execution is just a folder nobody opens. You are the execution engine that makes the plan real.



--------------------



Skills We Are Looking For

 campaign production and WordPress/Elementor publishing — preferred

Tools You Likely Know

--------------------



About Glass Design



Life is too short to not love what you do and who you do it with.

Glass Design is a second-generation, family-owned company that has served Southwest Florida since 1996. We are passionate about beautiful design, exceptional customer experiences, and building a team that genuinely loves what they do, wherever in the world they are based.

We run on EOS and live our core values every day:

We Choose Optimism · We Embrace Continuous Learning · We Relentlessly Pursue Improvement · We Get Sh!t Done · We Do the Right Thing

--------------------

--------------------



How to Apply

title: Remote Appointment Setter / Warm Lead Caller for Family-Owned Memorial Business
description:
We are a family-owned monument and memorial business in the United States. We help families with cemetery memorials, headstones, monuments, and related appointments.



We are looking for a part-time appointment setter / warm lead caller for approximately 15–20 hours per week.



This is an outbound calling role, but it is not a high-pressure sales job. We are not looking for someone aggressive. We need someone who sounds natural, patient, professional, respectful, and trustworthy on the phone.



Some people may be older, busy, emotional, or not ready to talk. The right person must be able to have a respectful conversation, ask simple questions, handle objections politely, and help set appointments for our memorial specialist when there is real interest.



This is a separate outbound calling and appointment-setting role. It is not the same as an office coordinator/admin position.



Main Responsibilities:



You will help with:



- Making outbound calls to company-provided leads

- Following up with people who may need monument, headstone, or cemetery memorial help

- Calling past leads, old quotes, cemetery leads, or other company-provided lists

- Asking simple qualifying questions

- Setting appointments for our memorial specialist

- Leaving professional voi
s when appropriate

- Taking clear call notes

- Updating a call tracker, spreadsheet, or CRM

- Marking call outcomes accurately

- Following a respectful script while still sounding natural

- Handling basic objections politely

- Escalating interested or sensitive situations to our team



The Right Person:



We are looking for someone who is:



- Clear and easy to understand on the phone

- Warm, calm, and respectful

- Confident but not pushy

- Comfortable making outbound calls

- Good with older customers

- Able to handle rejection without sounding discouraged

- Organized with notes and follow-up

- Reliable during scheduled hours

- Comfortable using scripts, spreadsheets, and call trackers

- Comfortable starting part-time



Required Skills:



- Excellent spoken English

- Phone support or outbound calling experience

- Appointment-setting experience preferred

- Customer service experience

- Ability to take clear notes

- Google Sheets or Excel

- Reliable internet

- Quiet work environment

- Backup internet or power preferred



Bonus Experience:



Please mention if you have experience with any of these:



- Appointment setting

- Cold calling

- Warm lead calling

- Real estate ISA work

- Insurance appointment setting

- Home services calling

- Healthcare or senior customer service

- Funeral home, cemetery, or memorial-related work

- Calling U.S. customers

- Handling objections

- CRM or call-tracking tools



Schedule:



15–20 hours per week.



Calls will be made during U.S. Central Time business hours. Exact schedule can be discussed, but availability during weekday U.S. daytime hours is important. Morning availability in Central Time is preferred.



Pay:



Pay depends on experience, phone quality, schedule, and performance.



Please include your desired hourly rate in your application.



There may also be an opportunity for performance bonuses after a successful trial period.



Application Instructions:



To apply, please reply with the word CALLER at the top of your message.



Then answer these questions:



1. Are you available to work 15–20 hours per week during U.S. Central Time business hours?

2. What is your desired hourly rate?

3. Describe your outbound calling, appointment-setting, cold-calling, or phone support experience.

4. What types of leads or customers have you called before?

5. Tell us about a time you handled rejection or an upset person on the phone.

6. What is your internet speed, and do you have backup internet or power?



Voice Recording Requirement:



Please send a short voice recording reading the sample script below.



“Hi, this is [your name] calling on behalf of our local family-owned memorial office. I’m not calling with anything urgent. I’m reaching out because we help families with cemetery memorials, headstones, monuments, and memorial planning, and I wanted to see if this is something your family may need help with now or in the future.”



The recording does not need to be perfect. We are mainly listening for clear English, a calm phone voice, and a natural, respectful tone.



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone respectful, clear, dependable, and comfortable speaking with families in a professional way.

title: Senior Amazon Account Manager (US Brand Agency) — Full-Time, Remote
description:
We're a US-based agency that manages Amazon for a portfolio of established health, medical, and wellness brands. We're small, fast, and unusually systematized — we run on documented SOPs, internal tooling, and a tight quality bar. We're growing, and we're looking for one excellent senior operator to own brand accounts and grow into a lead as we scale.



This is not a task-VA role. We want someone who can hold a brand's strategy in their head, make judgment calls without being told what to do, and be trusted with a real P&L. If you've run Amazon agency-side across multiple brands and you're looking for one stable, long-term home rather than a rotating client roster — read on.



What you'll own



Day-to-day management of assigned brand accounts in Seller Central — you are the person responsible for each brand's health, growth, and problems

Listing creation and optimization: titles, bullets, A+ content, flat-file uploads, and catalog troubleshooting (suppressions, variation issues, stranded inventory)

PPC (Sponsored Products / Brands / Display): campaign builds, bid and budget management, search-term harvesting, and hitting ACoS / TACoS targets

Keyword and competitor research using tools like DataDive, Helium 10, or Jungle Scout

Monitoring buybox, pricing, and unauthorized sellers — and flagging issues fast

Weekly reporting with a clear point of view on what's working and what to do next

Working inside our SOP and tooling system — and helping make it better

As we grow: helping QC and lead junior tea
mbers



Who we're looking for (required)



5+ years hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, ideally agency-side across multiple brands (not just one in-house brand)

Real PPC competence — you can explain your bidding logic and point to results you've driven, not just "I've run ads"

Comfortable with flat files and catalog troubleshooting

Strong written English — good enough to write to a brand owner directly

Willing to overlap with US Pacific business hours (we'll discuss specifics, but expect a solid morning-PT overlap for calls and real-time work)

Self-directed. You move things forward without waiting to be told.



Bonus points



Experience in health, medical, supplement, or other regulated categories (you understand why compliance and claims matter)

You've managed or trained other people

You're fluent with AI tools and use them well — but you know not to trust their output blindly

Familiarity with Keepa and reporting/dashboard tools



The details



Full-time, long-term, remote

Schedule: Mon–Fri, significant overlap with US Pacific hours; roughly 7:00am–2:00pm PT

Pay: $2,000–$3,500 USD/month depending on experience.

Growth: this is the first of a growing team. The right person becomes our lead.



How to apply



We read every application that follows these instructions — and we skip every one that doesn't.



Start your message with the word PELICAN so we know you read this far.

In 3–4 sentences, tell us about one specific Amazon problem you solved that you're proud of — what was broken, what you did, and what happened. Be specific; numbers help.

Tell us which Amazon tools you use day-to-day.

Tell us your favorite way to boost ranking (BSR). The more specific you are, the better. 



We move fast for the right person. Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid trial task before any final interview.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — SaaS, Meta API, AI Integration (Long-Term, Start ASAP)
description:
We are building a multi-tenant SaaS product in the social-media and ecommerce space and are hiring a senior full-stack developer for a long-term engagement, starting immediately. Initial scope is a 12-week MVP build, with strong preference for the right person to continue as the ongoing technical owner for maintenance, Phase 2 features, and Meta partnership work.



I'm a non-technical founder hiring my first technical lead. I value clear communication, working software, honest answers about what you do and don't know, and someone who will push back when I'm wrong.



This is a senior role. Please don't apply if you are a junior, a generalist, or an agency.



Required experience:

- 4+ years senior full-stack development with production SaaS shipped

- Direct production experience with the Meta Graph API and/or Instagram Graph API — non-negotiable, proof required

- Completed Meta App Review and Business Verification at least once

- Real-time webhook architectures (idempotency, redelivery, retries)

- OAuth 2.0 token lifecycle (encrypted storage, refresh, expiry, reconnect flows)

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture with strict tenant isolation

- Durable background job queues (Inngest, BullMQ, or equivalent)

- LLM API integration in production (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) — including structured outputs, RAG, and cost control at scale

- Postgres at production scale

- TypeScript / Next.js

- Stripe billing with usage-based metering

- Excellent written and spoken English



Bonus:

- Meta Tech Provider / Business Partner experience

- Shopify or ecommerce platform integrations

- Prior work on moderation, content intelligence, or social analytics products



Engagement terms:

- Long-term contract, full-time hours

- You work during your local business hours, available consistently — no US overlap required

- Aggressive MVP timeline, so steady weekly output matters more than which timezone you sit in

- Milestone-based payments tied to written acceptance criteria

- NDA signed at engagement start (required before any product details are shared)

- Full IP assignment of all code and work product to the client

- Client owns the GitHub repository and all third-party API credentials

- Weekly written status updates and a working demo at the end of each two-week sprint

- A short paid trial task (4–8 hours) before the full engagement begins, so we both confirm fit



Pay: We pay competitively for senior talent. Submit your weekly rate in USD with your application — strong candidates will not be filtered on rate alone.



To apply, send the following in writing:

1. Brief introduction and your weekly rate in USD

2. Years of senior development experience

3. Specific Meta API products you have shipped against (Graph API, Instagram Graph, Messenger, Marketing API) with a one-line description of each project

4. Your Meta App Review experience: which permissions were approved, how long it took, any rejection cycles and how you resolved them

5. One example of a webhook-driven, multi-tenant SaaS you have built, with brief architecture notes

6. How you would approach handling Meta's per-account API rate limits during a viral traffic burst (a few sentences — this is a sanity check)

7. Two references from prior SaaS clients (we will contact them)

8. Portfolio or GitHub link with relevant code samples

9. Your earliest start date and weekly availability



Applications that do not address items 3, 4, 5, and 6 will not be reviewed. We are evaluating multiple candidates this week and will respond to qualifying applicants within 3 business days. Generic copy-paste applications will be ignored.

title: Controller
description:
Cherry Hill Accounting and CFO is seeking a technically sharp, self-directed Controller to lead accounting operations across a portfolio of managed accounting clients and for the firm's internal operations. This role demands a practitioner who owns their workload, takes the lead without being asked, and brings the systems thinking needed to manage multi-entity, cross-industry accounting environments efficiently. You are fluent in QuickBooks Online, curious about AI-enabled accounting automation, and capable of delivering clean, audit-ready financials on deadline.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Client Accounting Oversight

• Lead month-end close for a portfolio of managed accounting clients; review and approve close packages, reconciliations, and

financial statements before delivery.

• Review client books continuously for anomalies, misclassifications, and control gaps; escalate material issues to the engagement CFO with documented findings.

• Manage client-specific chart of accounts, close calendars, AP/AR workflows, and reconciliation schedules across multiple industries and entity structures.

• Support onboarding of new managed accounting clients: system setup, data migration, chart of accounts design, and opening

balance reconciliation.

• Apply AI automation tools and QuickBooks integrations to improve efficiency and accuracy across the client portfolio.

Internal Firm Accounting

• Own the general ledger for MHL Advisory LLC; manage month-end and year-end close with variance analysis and written narrative for the Managing Principal.

• Manage semi-monthly payroll and coordinate domestic and international contractor payments via Wise, Deel, or equivalent

platforms.

• Coordinate with the external CPA firm on federal, state, and local tax compliance, filings, and planning.



ABOUT CHERRY HILL ACCOUNTING AND CFO

Cherry Hill Accounting and CFO is the managed accounting and fractional CFO practice of MHL Advisory LLC. We serve growth-stage and mid-market businesses with outsourced accounting, financial reporting, CFO advisory, and financial transformation. Practitioner-led. Precision-first.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5-8 years of accounting experience with at least 2 years in a controller or senior accounting manager role

• CPA or internationally recognized equivalent credential (ACCA, CPA Australia, or equivalent national designation)

• Expert-level QuickBooks Online proficiency; multi-entity, multi-industry environment experience

• Strong US GAAP and accrual-basis financial reporting knowledge

• Self-starter: takes ownership, identifies problems proactively, and drives resolution independently



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in fractional accounting, professional services, or outsourced CFO environments

• Hands-on experience with AI automation tools or QuickBooks integrations (Fathom, Syft, Dext, Vic.ai)

• Cross-industry accounting background: e-commerce, professional services, real estate, non-profit, or manufacturing

• Experience designing or improving internal controls over financial reporting



ENGAGEMENT TERMS

• Independent contractor agreement; full-time preferred, part-time considered

• Hourly or fixed-fee structures available

• All work performed remotely with consistent US Eastern time overlap

• International candidates welcome; US GAAP proficiency required

title: Fashion Designer & Product Development Specialist
description:

Our pieces are designed to feel elevated, modern, meaningful, and conversation-starting — blending biblical inspiration with luxury fashion aesthetics.



We are looking for a talented Fashion Designer to join our creative team and help bring new YESUGOD collections to life. We are not looking for basic designs. YESUGOD pieces should feel intentional, elevated, and unique. We want someone who can help us create garments that feel luxurious, meaningful, and fresh — pieces that people would want to wear because they look beautiful, but also because they carry a deeper message.



About the Role:

We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented Fashion Designer who understands modern women’s fashion, luxury streetwear, occasionwear, and elevated ready-to-wear. The ideal candidate can take a creative concept and turn it into clear design direction, sketches, technical details, and manufacturer-ready ideas.



You should have a strong eye for silhouettes, fabric, fit, trends, and brand identity. This role is perfect for someone who can balance creativity with commercial appeal and help us design pieces that feel unique, wearable, and true to the YESUGOD brand.



Core Responsibilities:



* Create original fashion concepts for women’s apparel, accessories, and future collections

* Develop sketches, design mockups, and visual design directions

* Create detailed tech packs for manufacturers, including measurements, construction notes, trims, fabric suggestions, and design specifications

* Research current fashion trends, luxury brands, fabrics, silhouettes, and styling direction

* Help refine existing garment samples by identifying fit, proportion, construction, and design improvements

* Suggest fabric types, GSM, finishes, trims, and hardware suitable for each design

* Create mood boards and collection concepts based on YESUGOD’s brand direction

* Work with our team to translate faith-based inspiration into subtle, elevated fashion pieces

* Communicate clearly with manufacturers when design revisions are needed

* Support product development from concept to sample approval



Trend Research & Creative Direction Responsibilities:



* Research current and upcoming fashion trends across luxury womenswear, streetwear, resortwear, occasionwear, accessories, and Christian/lifestyle fashion

* Study relevant brands, influencer styling, retail bestsellers, and emerging design details to inform YESUGOD collections

* Create mood boards, trend reports, silhouette references, fabric direction, color palettes, and styling concepts

* Identify commercially strong product opportunities that align with YESUGOD’s brand identity and customer base

* Translate trend research into original YESUGOD designs rather than copying existing brands

* Monitor what is selling in the market, including silhouettes, fabrics, colors, embellishments, fit preferences, and styling direction

* Present clear creative recommendations for upcoming drops, seasonal collections, and hero pieces



Ideal Candidate:



* Has experience in fashion design, technical design, or apparel product development

* Can create professional tech packs and clear design specifications

* Understands women’s fashion, luxury streetwear, elevated basics, occasionwear, and statement pieces

* Has a strong eye for fit, proportion, and garment construction

* Understands fabrics, trims, seams, stitching, lining, closures, and production details

* Can design pieces that are unique but still wearable and commercially appealing

* Is detail-oriented, responsive, organized, and able to meet deadlines

* Can work independently and take creative direction well

* Has strong English communication skills



Required Skills:



* Fashion sketching or digital fashion illustration

* Tech pack creation

* Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, Procreate, CLO3D, or similar design tools

* Fabric and garment construction knowledge

* Trend research and mood board creation

* Strong written communication



Bonus Skills:

* Experience designing for e-commerce fashion brands

* Experience with luxury women’s apparel, dresses, outerwear, bags, or accessories

* Experience creating 3D garment mockups or AI-assisted fashion concepts

* Knowledge of Christian fashion, modest fashion, or faith-based branding



To Apply: 



Please send the following:

2. Examples of tech packs you have created, if available

3. Your experience with women’s apparel, accessories, or luxury-inspired fashion

description:
About NGD Media



NGD Media is a dynamic and rapidly growing marketing agency dedicated to delivering exceptional digital advertising results. With a robust portfolio of over 65 active clients, our agency specializes in driving targeted traffic, maximizing return on ad spend, and scaling businesses across various industries. We foster a fast-paced, results-oriented environment where continuous learning and performance are highly valued. Joining our tea
ans stepping into a role with immediate impact and significant room for long-term professional growth.



Role Overview



We are currently seeking a highly skilled and motivated Google Ads Specialist to join our remote team. This role begins as a part-time, trial-based position designed to evaluate your strategic capabilities and technical proficiency within our existing workflows. Upon successful completion of the trial period, the position will transition into a permanent, full-time role. As a core member of our advertising department, you will be directly responsible for the health, optimization, and structural setup of numerous client accounts. This position is ideal for a proactive professional who thrives on data analysis and enjoys the challenge of scaling multiple campaigns simultaneously.



Key Responsibilities



The primary focus of this role is to ensure that our clients' advertising budgets are utilized efficiently and effectively. You will be tasked with the comprehensive setup of new Google Ads accounts, ensuring that all tracking, conversion actions, and campaign structures align with industry best practices.



Beyond initial setup, continuous optimization is a critical component of your daily routine. You will regularly analyze performance metrics, adjust bidding strategies, refine keyword targeting, and conduct A/B testing on ad copy to improve overall campaign health. Given our extensive client base of over 65 accounts, strong organizational skills are essential to prioritize tasks and allocate your time effectively across different projects. You will also be expected to identify new growth opportunities within existing accounts and implement proactive strategies to decrease cost-per-acquisition while increasing conversion volume.



Qualifications and Requirements



To succeed in this role, candidates must possess a deep understanding of the Google Ads ecosystem, including Search, Display, and Performance Max campaigns. Practical experience in managing multiple accounts simultaneously is highly preferred, as it demonstrates the ability to handle the scale of our agency's operations.



Candidates should demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex data sets and translate them into actionable optimization strategies. Familiarity with Google Analytics and conversion tracking implementation is also necessary to ensure accurate reporting and attribution. Furthermore, exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English are required to clearly articulate campaign performance and strategic recommendations to our internal team. A proactive mindset, resilience in a fast-paced environment, and a continuous desire to stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends are essential traits for our ideal candidate.



Compensation and Growth Path



We believe in rewarding performance and providing a clear trajectory for career advancement. The position starts at a competitive base rate of $7.00 per hour during the initial part-time trial period. This phase allows both the agency and the specialist to ensure a strong mutual fit in terms of skill and work culture.



As you demonstrate consistent success in optimizing accounts and driving positive results for our clients, there is a structured growth path to increase your compensation up to $10.00 per hour. title: Investment Analyst
description:
Investment Analyst — CERTUM Strategic Tax & Wealth Advisory / Premier Affordable Housing Fund



Full-Time | Remote | Immediate Start



About the Company

CERTUM is a premium tax and wealth advisory firm serving business owners, high-net-worth families, and sophisticated investors. We specialize in proactive tax architecture, wealth structuring, and advanced financial planning — not compliance work. Our clients come to us when they're ready to play at a different level.



Alongside the advisory firm, we operate Premier Affordable Housing Fund (PAHF) — a real estate investment fund focused on workforce and affordable housing across high-yield Midwest markets — and a property portfolio spanning hundreds of units. We acquire, reposition, and operate cash-flowing real estate using disciplined underwriting, value-add strategies, and tax-advantaged structures.



The founder, Jamal Hansen, is also a well-known content creator and educator in the tax, wealth, and investing space, with a large and growing audience across Instagram and YouTube where he teaches high earners and business owners how the wealthy actually build and protect money. Before you apply, go check 
 on Instagram and his YouTube channel — that content will tell you exactly who you'd be working for and the level we operate at. The platform is also a real part of the business: it drives clients, capital, and brand partnerships, so you're joining a company that is both an operator and a media presence.



About the Role



You will work directly with the founder, Jamal Hansen — a successful entrepreneur managing multiple companies across tax, real estate, and investments. Your job is to be the analytical engine behind our deals: underwriting acquisitions, building the models, and pressure-testing every number before capital goes to work.



This is not a passive spreadsheet job. We are evaluating deals, raising capital, and acquiring real estate at the same time, often on tight timelines. You need to be the person who can take a raw deal, build a clean model, and tell us in plain language whether it works and where the risk is. If you need every assumption handed to you, this isn't the right fit. If you think in numbers, take ownership of your analysis, and can defend it, keep reading.



As the fund and the portfolio grow, this role grows with it. You will be taught our underwriting frameworks and the tax strategy that sits underneath every deal — but you have to be coachable and genuinely eager to learn. The exposure you'll get sitting at the intersection of real estate, fund operations, and advanced tax strategy is not something you'll pick up anywhere else. We're looking for world-class A-players who want to build something and grow with the company long-term.

This role is vital to the next evolution of the company.



Key Responsibilities



Underwrite real estate acquisitions — build and maintain financial models and pro formas for single-asset and portfolio deals, including BRRRR, value-add, and Section 8 / HCV workforce housing

Run the numbers on every deal — purchase price, rehab, financing, rents, expenses, exit, and returns (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash, DSCR)



Conduct market research and comps on target Midwest markets — rents, vacancy, cap rates, neighborhood and demand trends



Perform deal due diligence — review T-12s, rent rolls, offering memos, and operating statements and flag anything that doesn't add up



Support PAHF fund operations — assist with deal pipeline tracking, investor reporting inputs, and capital deployment analysis

Build and maintain dashboards and trackers for portfolio performance across the property base

Incorporate tax strategy into analysis where relevant — cost segregation, bonus depreciation, and how structure affects investor returns

Prepare clear, decision-ready summaries — turn a full model into a one-page read that tells us go or no-go and why

Take on new analytical responsibilities as the fund and portfolio scale





Who You Are



You are genuinely strong with numbers and financial modeling — this is the core of the role, not a nice-to-have

You are detail-obsessed — you catch the broken formula, the wrong assumption, the number that doesn't tie

You can think independently and form a point of view, not just fill in a template

You can explain a complex model in plain English to someone who isn't going to read every cell

You move fast without getting sloppy and you take ownership of your work

You are coachable, hungry to learn, and want to grow inside a multi-company operation long-term

You are fully fluent in written and spoken English — this is non-negotiable for this role





Requirements



Advanced proficiency in Excel and / or Google Sheets — comfortable building models from scratch (this will be tested)

Demonstrated ability to build pro formas and understand real estate or investment returns

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

Background or strong interest in real estate, finance, accounting, or investments

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and availability during agreed working hours

Full written and spoken English fluency — non-negotiable





Training & Development



Comprehensive training will be provided on our underwriting frameworks, models, and tools before you are expected to execute independently

As new responsibilities are added to this role you will be fully trained on how to complete them before they become part of your regular duties

Certain analyses will be repeated consistently so you will have the opportunity to master them and become the go-to expert in that area

Jamal will personally invest time in teaching you how deals are evaluated across the fund and the portfolio so you understand not just what to model but why it matters

Training materials, SOPs, model templates, and video walkthroughs will be provided and stored in the company Notion and Google Drive library for ongoing reference

You are not expected to know everything on day one — you are expected to learn, apply, and grow





The Opportunity

You won't be buried in a corporate structure. You'll be in the room, seeing how a multi-company operation evaluates and acquires real assets at a high level, and growing with it.

There is real room to grow here for someone who performs.



How to Apply

All applications go through our application form — we will not be accepting resumes by
.



Fill out the form here: 







You'll be asked to provide:



A brief introduction — who you are and why this role makes sense for you right now

Your resume or professional profile link

A link to or screenshot of a financial model, pro forma, or analysis you've built (if you don't have one, briefly describe a deal or number you analyzed and what you concluded)

A short voice or video introduction (60 seconds or less) so we can hear how you communicate



Only applications submitted through the form will be reviewed.
