title: E-commerce Finance & Bookkeeping Manager
description:
About the Role



Our e-commerce businesses need a sharp, dependable finance person to own our day-to-day money operations. Think invoices and payments, our accounts-payable inbox, QuickBooks upkeep, reconciliations across Wise, PayPal, banks and processors, inventory tracking, reporting, and a hand in cash-flow forecasting down the line.

A heads-up: this isn't a checklist job. We're after someone who takes real ownership — spots the thing that looks off, digs into discrepancies, and flags surprises before they snowball.



What You'll Own



Invoices & accounts payable



Run the accounts-payable Gmail inbox and keep it organized with labels

Track vendor and contractor invoices: amounts, currencies, due dates, payment status

Catch duplicates, errors, and anything that smells suspicious



Payments



Prepare payments via Wise, PayPal, and bank accounts

Monitor what's scheduled, paid, failed, or overdue



Books & reconciliation



Keep QuickBooks clean and current

Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and payment processors

Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees, and payouts

Stay on top of processor reserves, holds, and delayed payouts



Inventory



Track stock levels and movements

Reconcile inventory against Shopify, suppliers, and warehouses

Manage purchase orders, supplier deposits, and incoming stock

Maintain inventory valuation, COGS, and landed-cost records



Reporting & planning



Track ad spend, shipping, fulfillment, software, and processing costs

Deliver weekly and monthly financial reports

Surface unpaid invoices, upcoming payments, and cash needs

Support cash-flow forecasting, budgeting, and planning

Keep documents tidy for accountants and tax season



What We're Looking For



A background in finance, bookkeeping, or accounting

E-commerce or DTC experience, ideally with 7–8 figure revenue brands

Solid QuickBooks skills

Hands-on with Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and online banking

Strong with spreadsheets

Comfortable with inventory, COGS, and reconciliations

Detail-obsessed

High initiative — you solve problems without being told to

Clear written English and reliable follow-through

Trustworthy with sensitive financial information



Speaking Up



When something unexpected happens, we need to hear about it fast. That includes missing or duplicate invoices, odd charges, changes to vendor payment details, failed or delayed payments, missing payouts, reconciliation gaps, processor reserves or account holds, inventory shortfalls, sudden cost spikes, or anything that looks fishy.

A good report covers four things: what happened, the financial impact, what you looked into, and what you'd do next.

What We're Looking For



A background in finance, bookkeeping, or accounting

E-commerce or DTC experience

Solid QuickBooks skills

Hands-on with Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and online banking

Strong with spreadsheets

Comfortable with inventory, COGS, and reconciliations

Detail-obsessed

High initiative — you solve problems without being told to

Clear written English and reliable follow-through

Trustworthy with sensitive financial information



How We Handle Security



You'll prepare payments, but final approval always stays with management. And any change to a vendor's banking details must be independently verified before a payment goes out.



To Apply



Tell us:



-A quick summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping background

-The software and payment platforms you've worked with

-Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory, and reconciliations

-A time you caught and resolved a financial discrepancy

-Your availability and expected hourly rate

-Your MBTI type

title: Human Resources (HR) , Payroll, & Operations Coordinator (California Labor Law) – Friday to Tuesday Shift
description:

Deloro Valley is a premier Event Venue dedicated to creating unforgettable, safe, and enriching experiences. Because we run a dynamic operation, we are looking for a sharp, self-motivated, and highly organized professional to handle our back-office backbone: Human Resources, compliance, and financial administration.



Job Overview

We are seeking a full-time HR, Payroll, and Operations Coordinator to manage our team’s hours, compliance certifications, camp permits, insurance, and bill payments.



This position deals heavily with California employment and labor laws. While you don't need to be an expert on day one, you must have the drive to study and learn these complex regulations. To support your growth, we will fully pay for your time spent training and studying these laws.



Key Responsibilities

-HR & Payroll Administration: Gather and verify weekly hours from individual staff members and department heads; process payroll accurately and on time.



-Labor Law Compliance & Policy Enforcement: Learn and master specific rules regarding meal/rest breaks, overtime regulations, and other standard workplace laws. Monitor time tracking and proactively help enforce these company policies across all departments.



-Compliance & Certifications: Track and monitor staff training progress and mandatory certifications to ensure 100% compliance.



-Permit & Insurance Management: Track, manage, and renew all necessary camp operational permits; oversee insurance requirements and ensure we meet all policy guidelines.



-Financial Accounts Payable: Manage and execute timely bill payments for camp operations.



Schedule & Shift Details

-Working Hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time) / Note: This is approximately 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT.

-Work Days: 5 days a week, likely Friday through Tuesday (Your weekend will be Wednesday and Thursday, as weekends are critical operational days for the camp).

-Break: 1 hour total break time per shift.



Quality Remote Work Setup -- Because you will be communicating with leadership and handling sensitive data, you will need a reliable remote working environment:

-Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace where you can focus and take meetings without major distractions.

Communication: A clear webcam and a reliable headset with noise-canceling features for tea
etings via Zoom and phone calls.

-Internet & Power: High-speed internet connection. A backup power solution (like a UPS) and a secondary internet option (like mobile data or a pocket Wi-Fi) are strongly preferred to handle occasional outages.



Qualifications & Traits We Are Looking For

-The "Self-Starter" Gene: You are highly self-motivated. When given training materials on California labor law, you dive in and master them.

-Meticulous Attention to Detail: You don't miss deadlines, you catch errors in time tracking, and you keep permits updated before they expire.

-Excellent Communication: Fluent in English (both written and spoken) with the confidence to conduct professional Zoom calls with department heads.

-Experience: Previous experience handling US payroll, bill pay, or general HR functions is a massive plus.



What We Offer

-Competitive Salary: $950 - $1,200 USD per month (depending on experience).

-Paid Training: We value growth. We will pay for your hours spent studying and training on California labor and employment laws.

-Stable, Long-Term Employment: A consistent schedule with a supportive, organized team.



To apply, please reply with:

-A brief summary of your experience with HR, payroll, or admin work.

-A quick description of your current remote work setup (internet speed and backup solutions).

-A link to a video introduction, so we can see how you communicate in meetings

-When you are available to start

title: URGENT Loan Data Analyst
description:
About the Role



We are an Australian-based private lender seeking a highly detail-oriented Loan Data Analyst with experience working alongside credit decisioning frameworks or rule books.



This role goes beyond basic data review — you will play a key part in structuring financial data in line with credit policy, ensuring our assessors can make fast, consistent, and responsible lending decisions.



Key Responsibilities



• Review and analyse customer bank transaction data (last 90 days)

• Categorise income, expenses, and liabilities in line with internal credit rules

• Apply and interpret credit policy / rulebook guidelines to real customer data

• Identify financial behaviours such as:



Gambling activity

BNPL usage

Payday lending / wage advances

Overdraft reliance

• Prepare clear, structured summaries aligned to decisioning requirements

• Flag inconsistencies, risks, or policy breaches for escalation

• Support continuous improvement of credit rules and data structuring processes

• Maintain strict privacy, confidentiality, and data handling standards

What We’re Looking For



• Experience working with credit rulebooks, decisioning frameworks, or lending policies

• Background in lending, fintech, credit risk, or financial data analysis

• Strong understanding of:



Income verification

Expense analysis

Liability assessment

Responsible lending principles

• Proven ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and risk indicators in transaction data

• High attention to detail and structured thinking

• Ability to follow and apply rules consistently (not just interpret data)

• Strong written English and ability to present clear, logical summaries

Important – Privacy & Data Handling



You will be working with sensitive financial data. All work must be completed in line with strict privacy and confidentiality requirements.

No customer data is to be stored, shared, or used outside of authorised systems.



Application Requirement (Mandatory)



To be considered for this role, you must provide:



A sample of a credit rulebook, decisioning framework, or policy you have previously worked with

This can be anonymised or redacted if required

It should demonstrate how decisions are made (e.g. income rules, expense thresholds, risk flags)

Examples of categorised transaction data, ensuring:

All personal information is removed or anonymised

No real customer names, account numbers, or identifiable details

Clear grouping of transactions (e.g. income, rent, utilities, gambling, BNPL, discretionary spending)



Applications without these examples will not be considered.



Why Join Us?



• Work with a fast-growing Australian lender building a scalable credit model

• Be part of a structured, data-driven decisioning environment

• Long-term opportunity with growth into credit risk and policy development

• High-impact role influencing how lending decisions are made

description:

This is not a slow, quiet admin job. It is high-volume, high-energy, and high-reward for the right person.



Start structure: Part-time for the first 2–4 weeks (4 hours/day, Monday–Friday) while you get up to speed. Strong performers move to full-time. Timelines are flexible based on fit and performance.

**Set up and monitor AI outbound phone agent workflows in Close CRM**

title: Voice AI Intake Agent Developer — Retell / Vapi — Phase 1 Standalone Test
description:
Job Type: 

Project-based / paid test first



Project Overview:



I am looking for a Voice AI developer to build a **standalone Phase 1 intake-only voice agent** for a mobile mechanic / field service business.



This is separate from my n8n / FieldPulse / CallTrackingMetrics automation build. Another developer is currently handling the first n8n automation proof test.



For this role, I want to start with a small paid Voice AI test that proves the agent can answer calls, collect basic service request information, classify the call, and produce structured output that can later connect to n8n, CTM, and FieldPulse.



Preferred platforms: **Retell AI or Vapi**. I am open to either, but I want the developer to explain which platform is better for this Phase 1 intake-only use case.



## Important Scope Boundary



This first Voice AI agent is **intake only**.



The agent must not:



* diagnose mechanical problems,

* estimate repair cost,

* quote prices,

* schedule appointments,

* dispatch technicians,

* assign technicians,

* promise arrival times,

* promise same-day service,

* create live FieldPulse jobs,

* make commitments on behalf of the business.



The agent’s job is to collect information and route the call for human review/follow-up.



## What the Agent Should Do



The Voice AI agent should:



* Answer incoming calls professionally.

* Explain that it will collect information so someone can follow up.

* Collect required intake details.

* Classify the call type.

* Flag incomplete calls for human review.

* Produce a transcript, summary, classification, missing fields, and structured JSON output.

* Send or simulate an
 recap and SMS alert during the test.

* Be designed so it can later connect to n8n, CallTrackingMetrics, and FieldPulse.



## Required Intake Fields



The agent should attempt to collect:



* Caller name

* Callback phone number

* Whether the callback number can receive texts

  Suggested wording: “Is this a mobile number we can text if needed?”

* City / ZIP where the vehicle or equipment is located

* Vehicle or equipment description

* Brief description of the issue

* Urgency

* Roadside / safety status

* Existing customer vs. new caller if clear



## Call Classifications



The agent should classify calls into categories such as:



* Qualified service request

* Incomplete intake / needs human review

* Roadside or safety review

* Existing customer follow-up

* Non-service call / sales / spam

* Out-of-area or maybe-out-of-area



For incomplete calls, the agent should list the missing fields and mark the call as:



**Needs Human Review — Incomplete Intake**



## Structured Output



The test should produce structured output that can later be used by n8n.



Example fields should include:



* caller_name

* callback_number

* can_text_callback_number: true / false / null

* city

* zip

* vehicle_or_equipment

* issue_summary

* urgency

* roadside_or_safety_status

* classification

* incomplete_intake

* missing_required_fields

* human_review_required

* transcript

* summary

* recording_or_call_link if available



## First Paid Test Deliverables



For the first paid test, I expect:



1. Voice AI agent configured in my account.

2. Intake-only prompt / rules / behavior.

3. Guardrails to prevent diagnosis, pricing, scheduling, dispatching, or response-time promises.

4. 8–10 sample test calls.

5. Transcript and summary output.

6. Classification and missing-field handling.

7. Structured JSON output.

8.
 recap and SMS alert, or clearly mocked/sample alert output if full alert setup is not included.

9. Final prompt/configuration.

10. Setup notes.

11. Loom walkthrough explaining how the agent works.

12. Explanation of what I can safely edit later myself, such as script wording, approved responses, alert recipients, and minor rule changes.



## Future Expansion



Later phases may include:



* Connection to n8n

* CallTrackingMetrics tracking number integration

* FieldPulse-ready customer/job payloads

* Better alert routing

* More advanced review workflow

* Miro flowchart update for the Voice AI portion



These are not required for the first test unless specifically agreed.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate has experience with:



* Retell AI and/or Vapi

* Voice AI prompt design

* Intake call agents

* Call classification

* Webhooks

* JSON outputs

* n8n or Make

* Twilio or SMS alert workflows

* CRM or field service workflow integrations

* Human-review routing

* Clear documentation and Loom walkthroughs



Direct experience with FieldPulse or CallTrackingMetrics is helpful but not required.



## Please Answer These Questions



Start your reply with:



**I can build the Voice AI intake agent.**



Then answer:



1. Have you built voice agents using Retell, Vapi, or another voice AI platform?

2. Which platform do you recommend for this Phase 1 intake-only agent, and why?

3. How would you prevent the agent from diagnosing, estimating, scheduling, dispatching, assigning technicians, or promising response times?

4. How would you handle incomplete calls and missing required fields?

5. Can you produce structured JSON output for future n8n integration?

title: We're Hiring: Creative Editor — Health & Beauty Dropshipping (AI Ads + VSLs + Static Images)
description:
We're a health & beauty dropshipping team looking for a Creative Editor who can produce a high volume of ads — videos and static images — quickly and consistently. If you understand direct-response, know what makes a thumb stop on Meta, and use AI tools to move faster, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a role for someone with real ad editing experience, not a beginner.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll combine sharp edits, AI-generated assets, UGC, and proven ad frameworks to produce creatives that convert — VSLs, short-form video ads, and static image ads. You'll be working with provided assets and templates to produce variations and new creatives at speed.

TASKS



Research the Meta Ad Library and competitor creatives for inspiration — identify winning angles, hooks, and formats worth adapting.

Edit AI VSLs using tools like ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Runway, Pika, and Midjourney (prompts and SOPs provided).

Edit short-form video ads in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — strong hooks, tight pacing, captions, sound design.

Produce static image ads for Meta — before/afters, comparison ads, infographic-style creatives — using Photoshop, Canva, or AI image tools.

Source and edit UGC, B-roll, stock footage, and product clips into cohesive ad creatives.

Produce platform-native variations (Meta feed, Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and translated versions using AI tools.



EXPECTED RESULTS



Deliver a daily batch of creatives (videos and statics) based on the day's brief.

Hit targeted KPIs such as 3%+ CTR and 3%+ conversion rate on tested creatives.

Fast turnaround on revisions.



REQUIREMENTS



At least 2 years of hands-on experience editing video creatives for the dropshipping/e-commerce space.

Health & beauty experience is a strong plus.

Solid understanding of online buyer psychology, scroll-stopping hooks, and what makes ads convert on Meta.

Strong grasp of hooks, pacing, retention curves, and direct-response principles.

Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Strong internet connection and a fast computer capable of handling video editing.



TECHNICAL SKILLS NEEDED



Proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or After Effects.

Working knowledge of AI creative tools (ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Runway, Pika, Midjourney, ChatGPT).

Photo editing skills (Photoshop or Canva).

Bonus: experience producing ads end-to-end with AI (AI avatars, AI voiceovers, AI-generated B-roll, AI image ads).



PERKS



Work from home.

Bonuses for each winning creative produced.

Long-term, stable role with consistent workload and room to grow.



HOURS

Full-time position (8h/day). Flexible schedule as long as you deliver creatives before deadline.

RATE

$5–8/hour depending on experience + bonuses.

HOW TO APPLY



Double-check that you meet the requirements and technical skills for the position.

Change the subject line to "I Want to Work for You M."

At the top of your message, write 4–5 sentences to introduce yourself and tell us why you'd like this position and why you're a good fit (please don't write more than that).

Add a link to your portfolio or reel showing examples of e-commerce ads, AI ads, VSLs, or short-form creatives you've edited before.

Include the word "mangga" at the very end of your response. Why? This lets us see who's actually paying attention.

title: Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background
description:
# Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background



**Remote | Philippines | Full-Time Contractor**



Oliant is looking for a strong **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA** professional in the Philippines to lead a growing remote team supporting construction technology, AI-assisted workflows, data quality, and project delivery.



This is not a basic QA role. We are looking for someone who understands construction drawings, project delivery, technical coordination, and quality standards — and who can lead a team with structure, patience, accountability, and strong communication.



The ideal candidate may come from an **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or technical QA** background.



## About the Role



As a **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA**, you will manage a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists working across multiple projects. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the team produces accurate, timely, and high-quality work.



You will review project outputs, guide tea
mbers, identify quality issues, improve delivery processes, and act as the first escalation point when something needs clarification or correction.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical construction knowledge with people leadership, quality control, and process improvement.



## What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities will include:



* Lead a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.

* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the team’s deliverables.

* Review work before it reaches the client or senior stakeholders.

* Ensure data accuracy, reporting consistency, and adherence to project standards.

* Help tea
mbers interpret construction drawings, 3D models, markups, RFIs, redlines, comments, and other technical documents.

* Support weekly workload planning and help assign tea
mbers based on project needs, skill level, and capacity.

* Maintain internal trackers, project status updates, and delivery documentation.

* Provide structured feedback to tea
mbers.

* Train junior tea
mbers on workflows, drawing interpretation, QA standards, platform usage, and delivery expectations.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

* Escalate blockers, risks, and quality concerns early.

* Coordinate with other remote teams involved in project setup, configuration, mapping, QA, and delivery.

* Participate in client-facing or internal stakeholder meetings when needed.

* Help create a culture of ownership, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.



## What We’re Looking For



You should apply if you have:



* A Bachelor’s degree in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering**, or a related construction / technical field.

* Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings, including architectural plans, sections, MEP layouts, structural drawings, fit-out details, and site-related documentation.

* Experience with BIM, construction coordination, project delivery, technical QA, or quality control.

* Experience reviewing technical work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch mistakes before they become client-facing issues.

* Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating other tea
mbers.

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Confidence working with spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and structured project data.

* Ability to learn new tools, platforms, and workflows quickly.



## Helpful Experience



The following experience is helpful, but not all are required:



* Autodesk Revit

* AutoCAD

* Navisworks / NWD model navigation

* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud

* Bluebeam

* Procore

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel

* Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject

* Construction progress tracking

* QA process design

* Data validation

* AI-assisted workflows

* Remote team leadership



## Who You Are



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented and quality-driven.

* Calm under pressure.

* Clear and respectful when giving feedback.

* Comfortable holding people accountable without micromanaging.

* Proactive in raising risks, blockers, and process gaps.

* Able to explain complex technical issues in simple terms.

* Fair, patient, and supportive with junior tea
mbers.

* Comfortable working with changing priorities.

* Interested in technology, AI, construction data, and modern digital workflows.



## Compensation



* **Starting compensation:** **$950 – $1,100 USD/month**, depending on experience and interview performance.

* **Strong candidates with proven leadership, BIM, construction coordination, or QA management experience may be considered up to:** **$1,200 USD/month**.

* Compensation is reviewed based on performance, reliability, quality of work, leadership, communication, and business needs.



This is a full-time contractor role. Weekend or rest-day work may be required depending on project needs and will be handled separately according to the project schedule and applicable rate structure.



## Role Details



* **Location:** Fully remote, Philippines

* **Type:** Full-time contractor

* **Schedule:** Full-time

* **Seniority:** Lead / Senior Technical QA

* **Reports to:** Delivery / Operations Management

* **Team:** You will help lead a growing team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.



## Why Join Oliant?



Oliant works with international clients and remote teams across multiple regions. We are building specialized teams around AI-assisted QA, technical validation, construction data, digital workflows, and project delivery.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond individual production work and grow into a leadership role where quality, communication, process improvement, and team development matter.



You will help shape how the team works, how quality is maintained, and how junior technical talent grows.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short introduction that includes:



1. Your background in Architecture, Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or QA.

2. The tools you have used, such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360, Procore, Bluebeam, Excel, or similar platforms.

3. Your experience reviewing drawings, models, reports, or technical project data.

4. Any experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating tea
mbers.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



We are looking for someone who can lead with quality, ownership, and good judgment. If that sounds like you, we would be happy to hear from you.
